invite.subject: You are invited to the Dijital Asistan admin console
invite.body: You have been invited to the Dijital Asistan admin console as an administrator. You sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your work email and two-step verification; there is no password.
invite.action: Open this link to accept the invitation: {url}
invite.expiry: The link is valid for 72 hours and can be used once.
invite.notYou: If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.

supportReply.subject: About your support request: {reference}
supportReply.footer: Reply to this email to add information to your request. Your request number: {reference}

securityRecovery.subject: Security event: a recovery code was used
securityRecovery.body: A two-step verification recovery code was used on an admin account ({time}). The authenticator enrolments of the account were removed; the next sign-in requires a new setup.
securityRecovery.action: If this was not expected, disable the account right away on the Admins page of the admin console.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your Dijital Asistan account and the data linked to it were deleted: your profile, settings, connected account links, briefings, analyses, AI memory, uploaded files and exports. Your request number: {reference}
accountDeleted.google: Google access was revoked. You can check it at myaccount.google.com/permissions if you like.
accountDeleted.microsoft: If you connected a Microsoft account, remove its access separately: account.live.com/consent/Manage or myapps.microsoft.com.
accountDeleted.subscription: Deleting your account does not cancel a store subscription. To avoid charges, cancel it in your App Store or Google Play subscription settings.
accountDeleted.backups: Copies in backups are removed automatically within 30 days.
